subject: [PATCH 12/22] mm/damon: restrict DAMON-native folio operations to common memory

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch restricts DAMON-native folio operations to common memory, preventing them from being performed on memory outside of N_MEMORY_COMMON. This change treats these folios like ZONE_DEVICE memory and prevents DAMON from acquiring or aging them. As a result, virtual address monitoring will report accessed pages as such, and migration is restricted to destinations within N_MEMORY_COMMON.
